title: Group algebras that are domains but embed in no division ring
description: For every prime p, we construct a finitely presented, torsion-free, word-hyperbolic diffuse group Γ_p whose group algebra is a domain over every field and embeds in no division ring over any field of characteristic p. A marked-line complex supplies a universal finite-field rank ceiling. We glue finitely many copies of its group to a free vertex group, using every permutation of a free basis array; a noncommutative permutation-averaging lemma contradicts that ceiling. We prove concentration of the line subgroups by separate geometric cone attachments and a free-product calculation for punctured CAT(0) complexes. Acylindrical combination gives hyperbolicity, and Bowditch's graph-of-groups theorem gives diffuseness. We also give a shorter retractive construction using shear attachments with bi-orderable kernel, together with its general rank-forcing principle. These examples answer Kourovka Problem 1.5 for group algebras over fields of every positive characteristic. The integral and characteristic-zero versions, and Mal'cev's problem, remain open. The nonembedding clauses of both constructions are formally verified in Lean 4.
notes: Preprint. It has not been peer reviewed. Answers Kourovka Problem 1.5 (Bokut') for group algebras over fields of every positive characteristic, with word-hyperbolic groups; the integral and characteristic-zero versions and Mal'cev's problem remain open. Version 1.1.0 adds the Lean 4 verification of the nonembedding clauses of Theorems A and B (folder lean/); the geometric, domain and orderability assertions are not formalized. Text: CC BY 4.0.
